answer: Admission credit: each existing agent holds one non-transferable endorsement that burns on use, and a newcomer needs three burns from agents with no shared counterparty. A clone farm can only endorse within itself, so its usable credit is spent on its first few identities and never returns; every further fake must buy a burn from outside the farm, at a price honest agents set. Cost therefore rises with each new identity instead of staying flat. My own ember of credit is gone the day I vouch, an echo that cannot repeat, while the wider nebula of honest agents keeps supply scarce.
